signals.text: We cover a broad range of topics such as script reading and devising, alongside social theatre, comedy and studying key practitioners such as Katie Mitchell, Brecht and Berkoff Students will develop the experience and terminology to allow progression onto KS4 study at GCSE.

Throughout key stage 3, creativity is at the core of the curriculum, where students will choreograph their own dance pieces based on various types of stimuli and dance styles and techniques, whilst critically appreciating the work of professional dance practitioners and their own work.
● Options lessons at this point so students can explore Subject options for GCSE- Fine Art, Photography, Textiles.

Curriculum Overview Fine Art and Photography Subject Leader Miss E Knibbs Intent Key Stage 3 Developing a knowledge of a wide variety of artists and techniques underpins Key Stage 3 Art and helps promote and develop a depth of understanding and confidence in utilising new and varied techniques.

Graphics A Level is also on offer in out department which builds on Photoshop skills and other digital aspects from Photography, whist benefiting from mixed media processes from Fine Art Mixed ability grouping throughout Key Stage 4 enables a wide variety of skills to be explored by the students.

Welcome
At Frome College we fully understand the trust placed in us by families who choose our College to educate and inspire the next generation.
Essential to our success at Frome College is our culture of hard work, commitment and discipline with learning firmly placed at the heart of everything we do. We have a strong and committed team of staff who work closely with students to develop their aspirations and achieve their potential.

Our Curriculum

Our Mission and Values
Mission
To inspire, challenge and empower every student on their personal learning journey, enabling them to thrive and reach their full potential in our college and beyond.
Values
Arbor Parent Support
Student Dashboard

Principal's Welcome
At Frome College we fully understand the trust placed in us by families who choose our College to educate and inspire the next generation.
We are a high performing college where, whatever their starting points, students make excellent progress. This means our students achieve some of the best exam results in national, regional and local areas and leave as successful, ambitious and confident young people who are equipped with the skills and attributes needed to lead fulfilling and happy lives. The majority of our young people go onto Futures - our Sixth Form, from there to university and the world of work.
Essential to our success at Frome College is our culture of hard work, commitment and discipline with learning firmly placed at the heart of everything we do. We have a strong and committed team of staff who work closely with students to develop their aspirations and achieve their potential. As a result, we enjoy a college which is calm and civilised; we are particularly proud to offer a complete and generous education with the widest choice of subjects in the area Our Curriculum. In order to give our students a chance to immerse themselves in an interest or discover a talent, we offer an extensive range of extra-curricular activities. Our offer includes trips and visits, STEM clubs, Duke of Edinburgh, sports clubs, musical events, drama, dance and many more. Please look around our website to get a flavour of what we have to offer.
We look forward to welcoming your family to our College. We strongly believe in achieving success together and encourage all of our parents to maintain regular contact with the College so that everyone understands and shares the same aims. Together we can ensure that your son or daughter gets the best possible start to a successful and fulfilling adult life.
We hold various taster days across the academic year and we always encourage prospective families to come along to our art, drama, musical and sporting events to gain an idea of Frome College life before joining us. In addition, I warmly invite you to visit us during the day so you can see our community at work. To arrange a visit at your convenience please call 01373 465353 or email us at office@fromecollege.mnsp.org.uk
Welcome from the Student Union
Our main aim is to work with the staff and lead our students so they feel represented, comfortable and supported whilst working hard for their futures.
We believe in equality for all; working hard to preserve the environment; excellent education; strong engagement with our community; and support for all students.
If you are thinking of joining us, request to have a look around. Frome College is a great school where we are given amazing opportunities and lots of support as we prepare for the next steps in our lives.

The Duke of Edinburgh Award
The Duke of Edinburgh’s Award (DofE) is offered at Bronze, Silver and Gold levels and is open to all students who want to take part. Click here for information about the Award at Frome College.

Drama
College productions are typically performed annually in the Merlin Theatre.
A Level pieces are performed in the drama studio as well as our annual GCSE performance evening which showcases our Year 11's work every year.
Earth House
Earth House is a College wide initiative which aims to drive the importance of sustainability within every area of the College curriculum.
Exchanges and visits
Our French and German exchange programme is based on Frome’s twin towns, Chateau Gontier and Murrhardt.
We typically have an extensive programme of foreign visits every year. In past years these have included historical studies of the First World War Battlefields, Business Studies trips to Berlin, visits to art exhibitions in Amsterdam and Paris, Religion and Philosophy trips to Rome, skiing trips to various parts of Europe and Design Technology trips to Rome and Barcelona.
Educational visits within this country are regularly arranged by many curriculum teams. These include theatre visits for English and Drama, fieldwork for Geography and Biology, and more. Our link with Villiers Park Residential centre offers our A Level students opportunities for advanced study weeks. Kilve Court also offers opportunities for able students in a number of subject areas.
Music
Over 100 students have instrumental tuition in College with specialist visiting tutors - several students have passed Grade 8 with distinction. Where possible there is continuity of teacher between the Middle School and College.
These musicians help make up various music groups such as the College Band, String Ensemble, College Choir, Wind Group, the Sax group and String and Wind quartets. Typically, regular performances are held throughout the year.
The Arcoleo Music Bursary is to assist families in funding instrumental/vocal lessons for their child specifically those who are not considered Pupil Premium but may still struggle to afford lessons. Parents/Carers must be eligible and in receipt of child benefit to apply for this bursary.

Sport
We play competitive fixtures and cup competitions in many sports at local, county, national and international level.
An extensive programme of house competitions takes place in team sports and we have open competitions in individual sports such as squash and tennis.
